# PR #3197: Patch: every screen's top-bar buttons match the home screen's round dark style

Closes #3189

## What changed

The top bars of `BackLink`'s `.screen-nav` and the landing's `.landing-corner` now share one skin. It is a new sheet, `apps/web/src/routes/top-bar.css`. The controls wear it through the class `top-bar-button`:

- **`--round`:** Friends and the gear, 44 px circles.
- **`--text`:** `← Back`, the home screen's Sign in / Account link, and the invite screen's Sign out, all dark brass pills.
- **Language:** the same skin plus its own 44 px pill shape in `language.css`.

The four per-screen copies of the skin are deleted: the gear block and the Back pill in `tavern.css`, the gear in `landing.css`, Friends in `together.css`, the language skin in `language.css`. So is the Account link's `.landing a.landing-corner-link` rule.

**Why Friends and Settings were square on `/replays`.** The old rules were `.tavern.app-shell .screen-nav button…`, and `/replays` and `/decks` have no `.tavern` root, so they never matched. `--tavern-brass`, `--tavern-gold` and `--tavern-gold-pale` were also declared only under `.tavern`. The new rule needs no `.tavern`, and `tavern.css` now declares those three tokens on `.tavern, .screen-nav`.

**The tavern rules that would outrank the shared skin** (the wood-button rule and the text-link rule) now skip `.top-bar-button` through `:where(:not(.top-bar-button))`. That adds no weight, so every other rule that outranks them still does.

## Departures from the plan

The plan was written before the issue gained the `← Back` scope addition and excluded Back, so I did the following beyond it:
- `--text` gives Back and the Account link one shared pill rule.
- `font-weight: 600` and `letter-spacing: 0.02em` sit in the base skin rather than in `language.css`.
- `tavern.css` loses its Back-pill copy. Its two text-link rules (`.link-button` and its hover) skip `.top-bar-button`.

Back is a 44 px pill (999px radius, brass border, `rgba(18, 11, 7, 0.65)`, `rgb(251, 231, 176)` text, no underline). The gear is a 44×44 circle and Language a 44 px pill.
  - Hover on Back and the gear gives the gold border, `rgba(90, 52, 27, 0.75)` fill and glow.

## What

The top-right buttons look different on the home screen and on every other screen. Make every screen's top bar match the **home screen**.

- **Home screen** (`routes/landing.tsx`, `.landing-corner`): the Jlore pill, Friends and Settings are all **round, dark** buttons — 44 × 44 px circles, a 1px `--tavern-brass` border, a near-black `rgba(18, 11, 7, 0.65)` fill, `--tavern-gold-pale` icons, and the gold glow on hover. - **Every other screen** (`routes/nav.tsx`'s `BackLink`, `.screen-nav`; seen on `/replays` on a phone at staging): Friends and Settings render as **brown rounded squares** (the wood button style), not circles.

The same components render in both bars (`JlorePill`, `FriendsButton placement="nav"`, `LanguageButton placement="nav"`, `SettingsButton placement="nav"`); only the CSS differs.

## Leads

- `.landing .landing-corner .settings-gear` (`routes/landing.css`) makes the gear round, but only on the home screen. Nothing gives `.screen-nav .settings-gear` the same rule.
- `together/together.css` already tries to make Friends round in the screen nav with `.tavern.app-shell .screen-nav button.friends-button.friends-button--nav…`, yet it shows as a square on `/replays`. Find out why that selector misses (the screen may not sit inside `.tavern.app-shell`, or a later wood-button rule outranks it) rather than stacking more specificity on top.
- The language button, where it shows (wider than 560px), should match too.

## How

Move the round style into **one shared rule** that both `.landing-corner` and `.screen-nav` use (for example a shared class on the round controls, or one selector list), so the two bars can't drift again. Delete the duplicated per-screen copies once the shared rule covers them. Keep the 44px touch targets, the hover/focus states and the existing phone layout (the language button still steps aside at 560px and below).

**The `← Back` link too.** Today it is a default blue, underlined text link (`.link-button`, `data-testid="nav-back"`). Restyle it as a dark pill matching the home screen's Account link (`.landing a.landing-corner-link`): 44px tall, `999px` radius, 1px `--tavern-brass` border, the same dark fill, `--tavern-gold-pale` text, no underline and no blue, with the same gold hover glow. Share the rule with the Account link rather than copying it. Keep the arrow, its `nav-back` test id and its behavior (including `onPress` guarded exits). On a phone it must still fit on one row with the pill, Friends and Settings, as the existing 560px rules arrange.

Out of scope: the board's own control bar (`placement="game"`).

## Done when

- On every screen with a `BackLink` top bar, Friends, Settings and (when shown) Language are 44px dark circles with the brass border, identical to the home screen's, on phone and desktop widths.
- The Jlore pill looks the same on the home screen and the inner screens.
- `← Back` is a dark brass-bordered pill matching the home screen's Account link, with no blue or underline, and the whole bar still fits on one row at 320px.
- The home screen looks unchanged.
- One shared rule defines the round top-bar button; no screen-specific copy of it remains.
- Web tests, lint and typecheck pass; any visual/e2e snapshot of a top bar is updated.
